title: Authorization principal
description: Trusted identity attributes derived from a verified access token. The synthetic evaluation role is carried in principal.roles, not here; the real IdP roles travel as attributes for audit and optional conditions (§6.4).

hospitalId.description: The active organization alias, or an empty string for a tenant-wide administrator session (issue #80/#81) - never absent: an omitted hospitalId is a malformed request, an empty one is a deliberate, distinct fact a policy can and must read.
